about.description: Mu Digital provides tokenized access to private credit and structured finance products, connecting institutional lenders with decentralized liquidity. It enables securitization of off-chain credit through on-chain smart contracts.
about.registryInfo: Mu Digital is a UK-based RWA tokenization platform issuing tokenized real-estate and trade-finance instruments under FCA-supervised structures.

fees.revenueNotes: Mu earns primary-market spreads on tokenized issuances plus ongoing servicing/management fees on the underlying real-estate / receivable pools.
